derivation:
by
  apply BialgHom.coe_toAlgHom_injective
  simpa [vectorGroupCoordinateBialgHom, vectorGroupCoordinateMap] using (SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι (R := K) (M := Module.Dual K V))
explanation: After forgetting the bialgebra structure and unfolding the coordinate map, this is the symmetric-algebra identity-extension theorem instantiated at Module.Dual K V; the dual of LinearMap.id simplifies to the identity.
